release: Shorts-LM research catalogue v0.1 — reconciled candidate release
purpose: Discovery seed catalogue plus synthetic Phase 4/5 contract fixtures. Not a real video dataset and not a cleared training corpus.
limitations: Catalogue rows are discovery leads or proposals; none independently proves active Shorts/Reels publication or rights to use media.
Hashtag popularity and retrieval yield remain unverified; Gemini's row-level evidence URLs are missing.
Synthetic test cases contain no media and are not a model-performance benchmark or gold set.
Gemini's official API recommendations conflict with repository ADR-003, which excludes official platform APIs.
No Phase 3 commands were run and no Phase 3 code was modified.
archive_note: Full CSV/JSON/JSONL release is distributed separately. Use scripts/install_research_catalogue.py to verify and install it under data/research_catalogue/v0.1/.
